title: HDFC Bank shares fall 2% to 52-week low: What's the reason? - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
At the time of writing, buy quantity stood at 51.90 per cent, or 19,14,143 shares, compared with a sell quantity of 48.10 per cent, or 17,74,158 shares. | Photo Credit: iStockphoto

HDFC Bank shares declined nearly 2 per cent in Wednesday’s session, hitting a fresh 52-week low as the stock traded below its previous close. The stock slipped to ₹690.65, marking a new 52-week low, before trading at ₹694.55 at 11.47 am.

The stock had closed at ₹703 on Tuesday. It opened at ₹698 on Wednesday and rose to ₹700 during the session before declining.

At the time of writing, buy quantity stood at 51.90 per cent, or 19,14,143 shares, compared with a sell quantity of 48.10 per cent, or 17,74,158 shares.

Total traded volume stood at 167.20 lakh shares, while traded value was ₹1,162.17 crore.

HDFC Bank’s total market capitalisation stood at ₹10.70 lakh crore.

The upper price band for the stock was fixed at ₹773.30, while the lower band stood at ₹632.70.

The adjusted P/E ratio of the stock stood at 13.52.
